sections.heading: Core Gameplay Mechanics
sections.body:

The game's intuitive controls allow players to easily drag and drop accessories onto the princesses, making it accessible to players of all ages.

One of the standout features of Cute Witch Princess is its ability to adapt to different play styles. As players progress through the game, they'll unlock new accessories and outfits, allowing them to experiment with even more creative combinations.
